items.title: Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum for $115 billion in an all-stock deal
items.tldr: Chip designer Marvell will acquire optical component maker Lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at $115 billion including debt, expected to close in the first half of 2028.

items.title: Google and partners dismantle XCPE botnet built into 1.3 million Android TV boxes
items.tldr: Google's Threat Intelligence Group and partners disrupted XCPE, a backdoor that a Chinese manufacturer shipped in more than 1.3 million Android TV boxes to rent out owners' internet connections.
items.byline: Krebs on Security, Ars Technica, The Register

items.title: Binance says a fake job interview started its $6.3 billion theft
items.tldr: Binance's incident report says a multi-stage attack beginning with a fake recruiter and malware led to the October 29 theft of about $6.34 billion, which the FBI attributed to North Korea's TraderTraitor group.

items.title: Apple warns memory costs are unprecedented as they squeeze margins and Mac supply
items.tldr: On its earnings call, Apple said memory pricing is unprecedented, forecast a December-quarter gross margin of 45 to 46 percent and expects Mac and iPad supply constraints.
